_comment: Licences a dependency may have (design 6.4), read by scripts/licence_check.py in the shared security-scan workflow ('security-scan / licences'). 'allowed' are SPDX ids anyone may add. An 'exceptions' entry lets one package (a glob, so per-platform builds match) use a licence outside the list: it says why, and the PR that adds it is the recorded human approval, so name it in 'approved_in'. A licence expression passes if it can be satisfied from the list: one side of an OR, every side of an AND.

exceptions.why: libvips, loaded by sharp, which Next.js uses for image optimisation in the website's server. Dynamically linked and not distributed to users.
CSS compiler used at build time by the website's tooling. Unmodified; MPL applies only to changes to its own files.
Accessibility rules in the website's development tooling. Unmodified, never shipped.
Browser-support data used by build tools (browserslist). Data, not code; attribution is in the package.
Small helper pulled in by electron-builder (via sanitize-filename) when packaging the desktop app. Build-time only.
